title: Correlation Between Trans Esophageal Pressure and Non-invasive Respiratory Support Failure in Patients With Acute Hypoxic Respiratory Failure
official: Correlation Between Trans Esophageal Pressure and Non-invasive Respiratory Support Failure in Patients With Acute Hypoxic Respiratory Failure
summary: This study aims at assessing the correlation between trans esophageal pressure and related respiratory mechanics (including, among others, nasal pressure-Pnose) and non-invasive respiratory support failure in patients with acute hypoxic respiratory failure of different etiology (including COVID-19).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age \>18 years
* Acute hypoxic respiratory failure (P/F \< 200)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Acute pulmonary edema
* Chest wall deformities
* Immediate need for Mechanical Ventilation
* Pregnancy
* Hypercapnic RF
sponsor: University of Modena and Reggio Emilia
